method: body of the plugin's own live search (marketplace search, shops=[wildberries]) read back from the connector cache, no extra request; sha256 pins this trimmed file; raw_sha256 is the full raw body, kept outside git. Trimmed to the first three of 100 products; opaque blobs that may carry session or address data (metadata.qv, metadata.kcl, products[].logs, sizes[].payload) replaced with <redacted>. The request's token cookie and deviceid header are not part of the body.

ground_truth.note: first three products as parsed by _card_item_dict at capture time: nm 355329855 MSI 101 812 ₽ was 142 995 ₽ qty 24; nm 370245679 Gigabyte 101 033 ₽ was 141 901 ₽ qty 37; nm 445317378 Gigabyte white 92 104 ₽ was 264 000 ₽ qty 1. A probe the same hour gave nm 355329855 the same product price on card.wb.ru v4, and identical prices with spp=0 and spp=30.
